info.name: School Management System - Complete API Flow Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive, End-to-End Postman Collection for School Management System backend.

Organized by logical business flows:
1. 🔐 Authentication & Session Flow (Unified JWT, OTP, Refresh Token)
2. 👑 Super Admin (App Admin) Portal (Approvals, Subscriptions, Razorpay, Support)
3. 🏫 School Admin Setup & Management (Step-by-step onboarding & operations)
4. 👨‍🏫 Teacher Portal Flow (Attendance, Timetable, Workspace, Grades, Leaves)
5. 👨‍🎓 Student Portal Flow (Timetable, Submissions, Materials, Exams, Fees)
6. 👨‍👩‍👦 Parent Portal Flow (Report Card, Child Attendance, Fees)
7. 🏢 Franchise Owner Portal Flow (Schools, Staff, Finance, Analytics)
8. 🎫 Support Ticketing System (Unified for All Roles)
